module_summary: 12-hour BCD clock: cascaded BCD digit counters for seconds, minutes and hours advanced on ena, chained by terminal-count enables, with a pm toggle.

anchors.name: ss
anchors.why: Two-digit BCD seconds counter 00-59; output port.

anchors.name: mm
anchors.why: Two-digit BCD minutes counter 00-59, advanced on seconds rollover.

anchors.name: hh
anchors.why: Two-digit BCD hours counter 01-12, wraps 12 to 01.

anchors.name: pm
anchors.why: AM/PM indicator register toggled at 11:59:59 rollover.

anchors.name: enable
anchors.why: Carry-chain vector: per-digit increment enables from terminal-count compares of lower digits.

anchors.name: ena
anchors.why: Once-per-second tick gating all counter updates.

groups.name: time_counters
groups.description: Cascaded BCD seconds, minutes, hours digit counters and pm toggle.

groups.name: carry_chain
groups.description: Terminal-count comparators producing per-digit increment enables.
